name: Armor
description: The armor styles, protective slots, and shield traditions of The Elder Scrolls: Arena

entries.content: Cuirass: The central piece of body armor shielding the torso, chest, and vital organs. Crafted as supple boiled leather, interlocking chain links, or solid plate harness fitted to the wearer.
Helm: Headwear providing critical defense against crushing blows, arrows, and glancing blades. Ranges from simple leather skullcaps and chain coifs to visored plate greathelms.
Pauldrons: Articulated shoulder guards that protect the vulnerable shoulder joints, neck base, and clavicle from downward cleaves.
Gauntlets: Armored handwear shielding fingers, knuckles, and wrists from disarming cuts and weapon impacts while retaining a firm grip on weapon hafts.
Greaves: Leg armor protecting thighs, knees, and shins against low sweeping strikes and piercing arrows in melee skirmishes.
Boots: Reinforced leather footwear or articulated metal sabatons designed for solid footing on treacherous terrain and defense against ground hazards.
Buckler: A small, highly maneuverable fist-held shield used in duelists' parries to deflect sword points and open opponents to immediate counter-thrusts.
Round Shield: A traditional circular wooden shield reinforced with an iron rim and central boss. Versatile and dependable in shield walls and skirmishes.
Kite Shield: An elongated shield with a rounded top and tapered lower point. Designed to protect the mounted knight or foot soldier from shoulder to shin.
Tower Shield: A massive, full-length rectangular pavise providing almost complete frontal coverage against volleys of arrows and crushing siege weapons.
